# Controller 1 for port/tools/test.py's battle scenario in jp: the shift
# check's tools/inputs/battle.jp.txt moved to the port's timing.  The port
# loads main_code and the overlays without the N64's DMA and inflate time
# (docs/PORT.md, "Timing"), so its title comes 130 retraces sooner and the
# opening logo scene (ovl_0A_05, which jp plays by itself) at 208, not 340.
# The first START (420 there, leaving the scene) is 130 sooner, the rest 155
# sooner (the mode menu, ovl_0B_01, comes back at 325, not 480): each line
# of that file moved so, nothing else changed.  The path and the reasons are
# in that file's comments.  Overlays in the port: ovl_0A_05 at 208, ovl_0B_01
# 325, ovl_0B_03 484, the arena (ovl_17_01) 930, the result (ovl_0B_07) 1952.
#
